```python
def fix_pdf(input_pdf):
    """Re-render PDF at high DPI to eliminate Type 3 fonts."""

        '-dSubsetFonts=true',
        '-dAutoRotatePages=/None',
        '-sOutputFile=' + tmp_pdf,
        input_pdf
    ]
    r = subprocess.run(gs_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode == 0:
        os.replace(tmp_pdf, input_pdf)
        # Verify
        result2 = subprocess.run(['pdffonts', input_pdf], capture_output=True, text=True)
        if 'Type 3' in result2.stdout:
            print(f"WARN: Still has Type 3 after gs: {input_pdf}")
            return False
        print(f"FIXED: {input_pdf}")
        return True
    else:

        return False
```

- bjb2-18868（~/.ssh/config 已配置）
- 项目代码目录: /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/
- 特征数据可能在: /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/data/ 或 /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results/

```bash
ssh bjb2-18868 "ls /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/data/*.csv /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results/*.csv /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/data/*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | head -20"
```

- 输出 LaTeX 表格

```
...
```

- 关键发现（family 内部一致性如何？哪个 family 变异最大？）
